Aspiring Software Developer with a strong foundation in AI, Machine Learning, and Full-stack Development. eager to contribute to innovative 
and impactful tech solutions. 
 
INTERNSHIP 
 
MERN Stack Development Intern Certification 
- Completed a MERN Stack Development internship, gaining hands-on experience in full-stack web development, RESTful APIs, database management, 
and Git/GitHub version contributions. 
 
PROJECTS 
 
Track It — Expiry Tracking & Predictive Analysis System Repo 
- Full‑stack Next.js + MongoDB application for expiry tracking. 
- OCR extraction using OpenCV + Tesseract with Modular APIs and automation. 
 
Live Face Attendance Tracking System using AI Repo 
- Real-time face recognition-based attendance system using Python, OpenCV, and SQLite. 
- Detects and logs multiple faces with high accuracy; includes GUI, spoof detection, and report generation. 
 
Smart Waste Segregation System using AI Repo 
- AI-powered waste classification system using OpenCV and TensorFlow to identify plastic, metal, and organic waste. 
- Integrated with Streamlit interface for real-time predictions and promotes automated, sustainable waste management. 
 
AI Research Hub Repo 
- Full-stack React + Node.js/Express application powered by MongoDB and Google’s Gemini API for scholarly analysis. 
- Implements a multi-document RAG pipeline, automated PDF parser, literature synthesis generator, and comparative matrix benchmarking. 
 
English Learning Web Application - Learning-Web-app 
- Developed an interactive platform to improve English speaking and communication skills through real-time practice. 
- Enable users to learn in a guided, distraction-free environment with simple and accessible features. 
CERTIFICATIONS 
Completed Machine Learning course training - Link 
Completed Basic in C - Link 
Complete C++ beginner to advanced level - Link 
 
CODING PROFILES 
Leetcode: 300+ Problems. Profile Link 
Hackerrank: 2★ cpp,4★ SQL,3★ C Profile Link 
Skillrack:1300+ Problems Profile Link 
ACHIEVEMENTS 
 
• Participated in 4x Hackathons, won in 1, and was a finalist in 2 hackathons in premier institutions. 
• Highest cutoff in HSC 2024 at Thiagarajar Model Higher Secondary School. 
• Ranked first in the SkillRack code platform at Sri Eshwar College of Engineering. 
TECHNICAL SKILLS 
 
 
Programming: Python, C++, C, Java, Data Structures, MySQL. 
Frontend: React, Next.js, HTML, Three.js. 
Backend: Node.js, Fast API, Streamlit. 
Database: MongoDB, Supabase, SQL. 
Libraries: NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Matplotlib. 
Tools: Git, GitHub, VS Code, Netlify, Kaggle, Google Colab. 
HARD SKILLS: Frontend, Backend, REST APIs, Authentication, Data Structures & Algorithms, State Management, MCP. 
SOFT SKILLS: Problem-solving, Teamwork, Communication, Analytical Thinking.
